accountContextMissing: An active local account is required before pairing a Host.
biometricFailed: Biometric check failed ({reason}); did not sign out.

codeError.invalid_pair_code: Pair code must be exactly 6 digits.
codeError.malformed: Enter the 6-digit code shown on the desktop.
codeError.malformed_request: The server could not parse the request. Update the app and try again.
codeError.pair_code_expired: That code has expired (5-minute lifetime). Generate a new one in desktop Settings → Companion.
codeError.pair_code_not_found: That code is unknown or has already been used — request a fresh one on the desktop.

codeHint: Find this code on the desktop PairDeviceCard, beside the QR. Useful when the camera can't focus on the QR (e.g. Android emulator).
connectedSubtitle: Live link — your desktop accepts requests from this phone.

diagnostics.rpcWaiting: Tap “Test RPC” to send a status RPC.
diagnostics.subtitle: Run an RPC and a streaming-event probe end-to-end.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.wsWaiting: Tap “Test event” to subscribe for 5 seconds.

discover.emptyDescription: Make sure the desktop is on the same network with the companion server enabled.
discover.foundCount: {count, plural, =0 {No servers found} =1 {1 server} other {# servers}}

help.tipEnableServer: Turn on the companion server in desktop Settings → Companion.
help.tipFirewall: Allow Cognia through the desktop firewall.
help.tipSameNetwork: Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi network.

discover.loopbackBlockedBody: It refused this browser. Open its Settings → Companion → browser access and add {origin} to the allowed origins.
discover.loopbackBlockedTitle: A Host is running on this computer
discover.precheckUnreachable: Couldn't reach this server. Make sure it's online.
discover.subtitle: Pick a server below, or skip to enter details manually.
discover.title: Find your desktop

fingerprintHint: This phone will refuse a different desktop signing key on every reconnect.
fingerprintMismatch: Server identity mismatch (expected {expected}…, got {reported}…). The pair code was already consumed — generate a fresh QR/code on the desktop and pair again.
formCardDescription: One-tap scan or manual paste — both routes use the same 5-minute pair token.

invitationSummary.description: Server v{version} · expires at {expiresAt, time, short}
invitationSummary.title: Invitation ready for {host}

httpError.401: Pairing rejected — the token may have expired (5-minute lifetime) or already been used. Generate a fresh one in desktop Settings → Companion.
httpError.403: Server refused the pairing request — check the desktop Companion settings for an allow-list.
httpError.404: Server doesn't expose the pairing endpoint — confirm the desktop is running cognia v0.2+ with companion enabled.
httpError.5xx: Server error (HTTP {status}). Check the desktop's logs and try again.

intro: Scan the QR shown in desktop Settings → Companion. You can also paste the 5-minute pair token manually.
loadingSlow: Taking longer than usual — your device may be slow to unlock secure storage. You can set up the pairing manually instead.

networkError.browserBlocked: The browser blocked the connection. Check the server's HTTPS certificate and its CORS or Private Network Access settings.
networkError.browserPolicy: The browser blocked the request because of its CORS or Private Network Access policy. Allow this web origin on the server, then try again.
networkError.certificate: The server's HTTPS certificate could not be verified. Check its hostname, trust chain, and expiry before trying again.
networkError.offline: This device is offline. Reconnect to a network and try again.
networkError.unreachable: Could not reach the desktop server. Check the URL, that Companion is enabled, and that the server is reachable from this network.

offlineSubtitle: Couldn't reach the desktop — verify the desktop is awake and on the same network.

payloadError.invalid: That pairing invitation couldn't be decoded — copy the full cgnp3|… string from the server and paste it again.
payloadError.versionMismatch: The server issued cgnp{got}, but this browser requires cgnp3. Rebuild the local server binary, or update and restart the deployed image, then issue a fresh invitation.

localNetwork.description: Grant local-network access so the phone can find the desktop on your Wi-Fi.
localNetwork.title: Local network access required

persistenceError: The device was registered, but its credential couldn't be saved securely. Pair again.

incompatible.description: This Host's protocol or feature manifest is incompatible. Switch Hosts or pair again with an updated Host.
incompatible.title: Host compatibility problem

offline.description: Retry diagnostics below, switch to another saved Host, or pair this device again.
offline.title: Host is offline

requiresGrant.description: This device is missing the exact Host capability: {grant}.
requiresGrant.instructions: On the Host, open Settings → Companion → Paired Devices and update this device. A Web client cannot grant itself Host authority.
requiresGrant.title: Host permission required

recovery.switchFailed: The saved Host could not be activated: {reason}

scanError.notPairCode: That QR code isn't a Cognia pair code.
scanError.permissionDenied: Camera permission denied. Enable it in system settings to scan QR codes.
scanError.unsupported: This device can't scan QR codes. Paste the pair token manually below.

signOut.cardDescription: Sign out and clear the device JWT. You'll need to scan a fresh QR to reconnect.

signOutDescription: You'll need to scan the QR again to reconnect.
signOutFallbackInvalid: Choose one of the saved fallback Hosts.
signOutFallbackRequired: A fallback Host is required before removing the active Host.
title: Connect to desktop

web.baseUrlLocked: Server URL is set by this deployment
web.clipboardReadFailed: The browser could not read the clipboard. Paste the full invitation manually.
web.clipboardWriteFailed: The browser could not copy the command. Select it and copy it manually.
web.codeHint: Generate a one-time invitation on the server with “cognia-server pair”, or copy it from desktop Settings → Companion.
web.deploymentCommandHint: Run this inside the target Host instance. In a multi-tenant or multi-replica deployment, replace the namespace and Pod name with the exact Host the browser should connect to. If it prints cgnp2, update the deployed image and restart or roll out that Host before retrying.
web.formCardDescription: Paste the one-time cgnp3 invitation issued by your cognia server.
web.headlessDescription: Run this in a second terminal while the headless server is running, then paste the printed cgnp3 invitation below.
web.httpsRequired: Browser pairing requires HTTPS so the pair credential is never sent in cleartext. Use an HTTPS companion URL.
web.intro: Connect this browser with a one-time invitation issued by your cognia server.
web.pasteHint: Paste the full cgnp3|… invitation; the server address and identity are verified automatically.
web.storageNotice: The device credential is kept in this browser's localStorage: anyone with access to this browser profile — or a script injected into this origin — could use it. Pair from a trusted device and sign out when you're done.
web.title: Connect to your server
